summary_md: **Mitzael Serna ([@kscius](https://x.com/kscius/status/2115875283291041967))** points to **Repowise**, which indexes code, git history and tests locally so agents can query what calls what, what breaks and what to fix first over MCP, with graph, risk, health and dead-code analysis needing no API key ([repowise-dev/repowise](https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise)).
